audience: shippers who book parcels, labels and pickups with SpedirePRO

useCases.title: Compare courier rates for a parcel
useCases.text: List the couriers enabled on the account with their aliases. Then get the rates for a route and parcel before you book.

useCases.title: Track shipments and read their event history
useCases.text: List shipments filtered by status or reference. Open one shipment for its status and read its event history.

useCases.title: Find a locker or post office near an address
useCases.text: Look up a postcode to check the address data. Then search the lockers and post offices near that place for a drop-off point.

useCases.title: Create a shipment and download its label
useCases.text: Check the courier alias and the wallet credit first. Then create the shipment, which charges the wallet, and get the label PDF link.

useCases.title: Book a courier pickup for existing shipments
useCases.text: Book a courier pickup on one date for a list of shipment references. The courier collects the parcels at the sender address.
